mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.5%, it signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenue expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing slowdown regime (INDPRO below 100), declining industrial production signals reduced corporate output and potential earnings cuts, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC for the regime condition is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly growth in real GDP (GDPC1) indicates expanding economic activity that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 grows, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market overheating regime (PAYEMS growth exceeding 200k per month), strong employment growth may lead to premature monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth > 200, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises (FEDFUNDS > 0.25%) and the unemployment rate falls (UNRATE < 5.0%), it signals a tightening monetary policy amid a strong labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
